$comment: DRAFT verify-deployment task scaffolded by /prepare-for-swarm for Render. Adapt acceptance criteria to your project before relying on it.
title: Verify Render deployment
description: Confirm the latest Render deploy is live and healthy without modifying source. If verification fails because the deploy is broken, capture the failure and report it — do not edit production code to make the check pass.
steps: Confirm the build artifact exists and the deploy command (`render deploys create --wait`) completed without error.
Render runs the configured health check path; the deploy must reach `live` status before it counts.
Confirm no error-level logs in the first minute after deploy.
Record the deployed URL/version and the health-check result.
acceptance_criteria: Health check returns a successful (2xx / ready) response.
No new error-level logs attributable to this release.
Deployed URL/version recorded in the task output.
constraints: Verification only — do not modify source to make the check pass.
Do not promote to production from this task; promotion is a separate explicit step.
